## Purpose

Review every sheet of the ROS LL 4.2.0 model in a separate, concise document.

This index follows model/workbook order, including META. O-INFO and V-INFO retain their existing review notes.

The model defines mandatory status. Field meaning, source coverage and reporting rules are reviewed separately.

Mandatory fields are displayed first. Optional fields are grouped in one collapsible section per sheet.

META supplies the import entry point; its detailed user-supplied metadata review remains deferred.

Review [database destinations and import obligations](../09-database-import/ll-database-import.html) before continuing source coverage.

Complete the sheet review before selecting the questions to raise with Emmanuel (IOTC).

## Review approach

Review [row presence](../09-database-import/index.html#sheet-row-presence) separately from mandatory fields for each sheet.

For any row that must be exported, identify a source or an agreed reporting rule for every mandatory field.

Then review optional source values, reference correspondences, calculations and missing information.

Distinguish recorded observations from constants, assumptions and placeholders in the existing exporter.

Record proposed choices without closing a decision until it is agreed.

The prepared documents include every model field; they are not complete or approved field-to-source mappings.

Use [export design](../export-design.html) for shared decisions and the agreed export scope.

Use the [reference inventory](../04-references-code-lists/ll-reference-correspondences.html) for catalogue correspondence findings.

## Source conventions

Target model: `ros.form.model/inst/models/4.2.0/ll-form.yaml`.

Intermediate model: `ros.form.observe/inst/models/10.0/ll-form.yaml`.

Philippe export: `ros_ll_iotc_v2.1`, including its R script and SQL queries.

Source schema: ObServe 10.0; frozen IRD references: `20261112T184113Z`.

Initial preparation used schema and code; the linked live-data check now measures source population.

Delivery levels and the future R API remain separate decisions.
